notes.title: Patch notes Leap of Faith 1.0.3s
notes.notes:
Added four more songs from Katrina Stone.
Fixed the 'wiggle' achievement not triggering.

notes.title: Small patch update
notes.notes:
- typos corrected
- ringtones exchanged with new ones
- "social butterfly" achievement should trigger properly now
(achievement should pop already at Stephs' letter in chapter 3).

notes.title: Patch Notes LoF 1.0.1
notes.notes:
Fixes:
- Typos
- Added phone music info for chapter 8
- Updated custom ringtones for the in-game phone

Notice:
- The plane party is not bugged. Check the same app earlier in the chapter
- Unfortunately, I can't fix the save game problems from the previous version some of you had, as it will most likely ruin newly created saves from this release, so I had to let nature run its course on that one I'm afraid.

notes.title: Leap of Faith - Chapter 8 release date.
notes.notes:
Leap of Faith - Chapter 8 will hit Steam on 9th of September 2022.

The last half year has been both hectic and fun, and it's with mixed feelings I'm closing up Leap of Faith with the 8th and final conclusion chapter. I will miss the guys when it's all over.

Hope to see you on the 9th of September!
